title: H0083 (2022 Regular): Domestic Violence

other_topics: judicial-criminal-justice: Section 1 (new s. 784.04875) — creates a general misdemeanor domestic violence offence

operative_text:
Section 3 (s. 790.233(3), F.S.): A person may not have in his or her care, custody, possession, or control a firearm or any ammunition if the person:
Section 3 (s. 790.233(3)(b), F.S.): Has been convicted of a misdemeanor offense of domestic violence.
Section 3 (s. 790.233(4), F.S.): A person convicted of a misdemeanor offense of domestic violence must, upon conviction, be required to surrender all firearms and ammunition in his or her possession as provided for in subsection (5).
Section 3 (s. 790.233(5)(b), F.S.): The law enforcement officer shall take possession of all surrendered firearms and ammunition owned by the defendant and any license to carry a concealed weapon or firearm issued under s. 790.06.
Section 3 (s. 790.233(7), F.S.): A person who violates this section commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.
Section 4 (new s. 790.234(2), F.S.): When at the scene of an alleged act of domestic violence, a law enforcement officer must remove a firearm from the scene if:
Section 4 (new s. 790.234(3)(b), F.S.): Provide for the safe storage of the firearm during the pendency of any proceeding related to the alleged act of domestic violence.
